faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post at IIT Delhi is 20 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post in the current recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi. Interested candidates should check the notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical posts at IIT Delhi. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post will receive a salary of Rs.78,000/-p.m. plus HRA @30%. This is a contractual position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post at IIT Delhi is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree with five years' experience or PhD with two years' experience. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Four Years Graduate degree with five years' experience or PG degree with three years' experience or PhD is required.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post involves two main stages: shortlisting of eligible candidates based on their applications, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.answer: The job location for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical post is New Delhi, Delhi, with pincode 110016. The position is based at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus.
